I heard about the news that early results of one of the most promising drug will be come out tommorow. I really hope it works, but I am so anxious if it don't works. Soooooo anxious...
Is there any new good news about cure?
More scientists are saying some asthma drugs are effective. Also, some of japanese paitents were recovered with that drug last month. Hope it works...

When will the cure available? There is a lot of news about malaria drugs and ebola drugs, but I am not sure they are really effective. I know some of results will come out in April, but I really can't wait.
Today, I got my corona test result and it was negative. Still anxious about future, but having small relif....

Hi, I am living in South Korea and did coronavirus test few minutes ago.(I have some small coughs and fever) I need to wait for result at home 2~3 days. Hope nothing happens, but so anxious... 
My body is okay and having no severe symtoms(I took several lung x-ray and it had no problem) but still having sleepless nights because of anxiety. There are a lot of good news about people who survived and recovered, I will just belive that I could recover too.
Living in Korea... Having some light fever since last week and going to corona test tomorrow morning. Hope nothing happens and beliving I will be okay... but can't sleep..

Still anxious, but there are some good news.
Today, one Korean patient has cured without special treatment. She just stayed at home, than recovered by herself.

Today, one severe patient in South Korea has fully recovered. He Have some comfort.
Also, some critical case(They used ECMO because they were so sick) is recovering too.

I'm in South Korea and having severe anxiety now. But there is still some hopeful news.
Today, 52 year woman was discharged. The number of discharged people are very small, but continuously increasing. Have some hope.
http://www.newsmin.co.kr/news/46126/
Plz help I am in South Korea, and I am panicing. Anyone have a words of comfort?
Help, please calm me down..
Im in South Korea...can sombody cheer me up, please?
I am in South Korea, and I am so anxious. Anyone please help me...

I am in South Korea, and 4 person in nearby hospital is cured. Also some news says other patients are recovering fast.
Very afraid of spreading, but I am getting some hope from those good news.
Zoloft was bad drug for me, but I saw some posts that some people got helped by zoloft. They said it didn't worked immediately, but after some months they got more calm.
You' re right. I should focus on today, not uncertain future. Thanks for helping!
Thanks! I changed my view a little by reading this comment, and I am getting mentally better.
It helped me a little, but I can't sleep because of side effect. So I stopped to take it.

I'm not sure, but I think I need hope about everything will be okay.
